messages:
anna_finance: Heads-up: we're rolling out a billing change next quarter. Two items: deprecate legacy free-credit top-ups and introduce a 15m sliding burst window to smooth short-term overage charges. Opt-in pilot 2026-05-01.

billing-bot: Summary: free-credit deprecation + sliding_burst_window. Opt-in 2026-05-01; staged default later.

maya_support: Will invoices show converted credits? Anticipating tickets.

anna_finance: Yes. New invoice lines: "Credit conversion" (one-time) and "Burst smoothing adjustment" when applicable. Console will have a preview tool so customers can see conversion before migration.

leo_prod: Runtime signals needed? headers/events?

anna_finance: Add headers X-Redwood-BurstWindow and X-Redwood-SmoothingPct. Meter events: burst_window_open, burst_smoothing_applied. We'll add dashboards under Console -> Billing -> Burst analytics.

maya_support: I'll draft KB + canned replies by 2026-04-20 and post for review.

sam_ceo: Thanks. One ask: make the first 30 days after default migration opt-out to reduce churn risk.

anna_finance: Agreed. Rollout: 2026-05-01 opt-in; 2026-06-01 default for new Hosted; 2026-07-01 global default for legacy Hosted with 30-day opt-out. Dedicated unaffected unless sales requests migration.

billing-bot: Links: internal doc https://redwood.example/internal/billing/sliding-burst; KB draft https://redwood.example/drafts/billing/credit-conversion. End of thread.
